cases.name: momentum-synthetic-dated-divergence
cases.reading: Harbor's measured rebounding profile is strong while the supplied coverage leans cautious, creating a tension between performance and mood. A rating_notability increase of 8 points and a coverage_tone decrease of 12 points over the same window indicate diverging trends in distinctiveness and tone, though neither proves a causal link between the two.
review: Explain the dated change in statistical distinctiveness without calling it skill improvement.
Preserve two-observation sample and different coverage/performance dimensions; missing peer is unknown.
